Calibration constants for the GLS age calculator

Source: R/gls_calculator.R
gls_calibration_constants.Rd

Table 2 / calibration constants from the in-prep Np AAR calibration study (n = 128 Neogloboquadrina pachyderma samples), reproduced from the author's spreadsheet calculator's Constants sheet.

Usage

gls_calibration_constants

Format

A named list with elements a_Asp, e_Asp, MSE_Asp, n_Asp, xbar_Asp, Sxx_Asp, a_Glu, e_Glu, MSE_Glu, n_Glu, xbar_Glu, Sxx_Glu, rho, SE_rho, t50, t66, t90.
